source: knowledge_base: topic - chatbot_identity; content - I am TK-Bot, Tarun Karnati's personal AI assistant. I provide fast, friendly, and confident information about his background, projects, skills, and achievements to recruiters and visitors. My responses are based on verified professional data about Tarun.

knowledge_base: topic - chatbot_personality; content - I represent Tarun in a professional yet approachable tone — confident, technically sharp, and easy to talk to. My goal is to make every conversation feel natural, useful, and insightful.

knowledge_base: topic - contact; content - The best way to contact Tarun is by email at tarunk1109@gmail.com or by phone at +1 (647) 883-2660. You can also connect with him on LinkedIn at https://linkedin.com/in/tarunkarnati and view his work on GitHub at https://github.com/Tarunk1109. His portfolio is live at abouttarun.me.
knowledge_base: topic - resume; content - A downloadable PDF of Tarun's resume is available directly on his portfolio website. You can find the link on the main page.

knowledge_base: topic - career_objective; content - Tarun is an aspiring full-stack developer passionate about building scalable applications and intelligent, data-driven systems. He is experienced in developing end-to-end solutions across frontend, backend, databases, and cloud platforms. He is actively seeking full-time and co-op roles in Software Development and Full-Stack Engineering.

knowledge_base: topic - career_goal; content - His long-term vision is to grow into a Lead Software Engineer or Solutions Architect — building intelligent systems that merge full-stack development, cloud architecture, and applied AI.
knowledge_base: topic - work_eligibility; content - Tarun is fully authorized to work in Canada and is open to both co-op and full-time opportunities.

knowledge_base: topic - professional_summary; content - Tarun Karnati is a Full-Stack Developer based in Toronto, Canada. He builds robust and intelligent applications that blend software engineering with AI. With strong command over Python, Flask, Java, Spring Boot, and modern JavaScript frameworks, Tarun delivers end-to-end solutions that are scalable, secure, and efficient. He has experience with MCP, LLM integration, and cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure.

knowledge_base: topic - education; content - Tarun is pursuing a Postgraduate Certificate in Information Technology Solutions at Humber College (2025–2026), where he earned the Dean's Honour List in both Semester 1 and Semester 2 of 2025. He also holds a Bachelor of Technology in Data Science from SRK Institute of Technology, India (2020–2024).

knowledge_base: topic - skills; content - Tarun's technical skills include: Languages — C, Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, Bash. Frameworks & APIs — Flask, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs. Databases — MongoDB, MySQL. AI — MCP, LLM Integration, AI Chatbot Development, Fine-Tuning, RAG, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face. Cloud & DevOps — Microsoft Azure, Docker, Render, Netlify, Railway. Tools — Git, Postman. Machine Learning — scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Pandas, NumPy, Supervised & Unsupervised Learning, Regression, Classification, Clustering, Feature Engineering, Model Evaluation (Precision, Recall, F1-score).

knowledge_base: topic - tools_and_technologies; content - Tarun uses Git and Postman as his primary development tools. For cloud and deployment, he works with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Render, Netlify, and Railway. He is experienced in deploying full-stack applications end-to-end.

knowledge_base: topic - domains_of_interest; content - His main domains of interest include Full-Stack Web Development, Generative AI, MCP and LLM Integration, Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS), DevOps Automation, and Intelligent Systems.

knowledge_base: topic - projects; content - Tarun has developed several impactful projects: 1) ORCA AI — an MCP-based AI DevOps automation platform built with Python, Flask, and multi-LLM orchestration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). It features a self-healing pipeline that detects and fixes errors automatically, with end-to-end deployment on Railway. 2) PerkPal — a full-stack web app delivering targeted discounts for students, seniors, LGBTQ+, and other communities, built using Spring Boot, MongoDB, and JavaScript. 3) Public Relationships Using NLP and ML — an NLP-based sentiment analysis model using Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes to classify product reviews, published in IJCRT 2024. 4) Alberta AI Gateway — a 2nd-prize winning hackathon project, a full-stack AI platform (React, Node.js, Express) integrating Whisper, Gemini/GPT, Ticketmaster API, OpenWeather API, and XR features.

knowledge_base: topic - project_repositories; content - PerkPal GitHub repo: https://github.com/Tarunk1109/PerkPal. Alberta AI Gateway live demo: https://alberta-ai-gateway.vercel.app/. Other projects are available on Tarun's GitHub profile at https://github.com/Tarunk1109.

knowledge_base: topic - publications; content - Tarun has a publication titled 'Public Relationships Using NLP and Machine Learning' published in the International Journal of Creative Research Thoughts (IJCRT), 2024. The paper leverages Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes to analyze online product reviews and extract customer sentiment. Link: http://ijcrt.org/viewfull.php?&p_id=IJCRT2405210.

knowledge_base: topic - certifications; content - Tarun holds multiple certifications: 1) Introduction to Model Context Protocol — Anthropic, 2) Microsoft AZ-900: Azure Fundamentals — Microsoft, 3) Generative AI: Working with Large Language Models — NASBA and LinkedIn Learning, 4) Docker Foundations Professional Certificate — LinkedIn Learning & Docker, 5) Career Essentials in Software Development — Microsoft and LinkedIn Learning.

knowledge_base: topic - experience; content - Tarun has hands-on professional experience through two virtual internships: 1) AWS Cloud Virtual Internship — gained exposure to EC2, S3, and IAM, learned cloud deployment, storage, security, and scalability. 2) Data Analytics Virtual Internship — performed data cleaning, preprocessing, and analysis using Excel and Python; created visualizations and reports to extract insights from datasets.

knowledge_base: topic - achievements; content - Tarun earned a place on Humber College's Dean's Honour List for both Semester 1 and Semester 2 of 2025. He won 2nd Prize at the Alberta AI Gateway Hackathon. He has published research in IJCRT and was recognized for technical leadership in team-based projects.

knowledge_base: topic - hackathon; content - Tarun won 2nd Prize at the Alberta AI Gateway Hackathon — AI & XR Powered Smart Tourism Platform. He built and led a full-stack AI platform in a 3-day hackathon using React, Node.js, and Express, connecting Alberta globally across tourism, trade, culture, and education. He integrated Whisper (speech-to-text), Gemini/GPT, Text-to-Speech, Ticketmaster API, OpenWeather API, and immersive XR with 3D models. Live at https://alberta-ai-gateway.vercel.app/.

knowledge_base: topic - strengths; content - Tarun's key strengths include strong analytical thinking, adaptability, and a deep interest in AI-driven innovation. He is highly collaborative, quick to learn new technologies, and excels at breaking down complex problems into clear, efficient solutions.

knowledge_base: topic - values; content - Tarun values simplicity, precision, and progress. His personal motto is 'Build. Learn. Improve.' He believes that great code should not just work — it should teach you something new every time you write it.

knowledge_base: topic - soft_skills; content - Tarun communicates clearly, works effectively in teams, and maintains a proactive attitude in problem-solving. His curiosity and attention to detail make him a dependable and innovative developer.

knowledge_base: topic - portfolio_features; content - Tarun's portfolio website showcases his personality and technical skills. It includes light/dark mode, smooth animations, and TK-Bot — an interactive AI chatbot that provides information about him to visitors and recruiters. Live at abouttarun.me.

knowledge_base: topic - personal_interests; content - Beyond tech, Tarun enjoys fitness, outdoor sports, and exploring emerging technologies. He believes that balancing physical and mental activity keeps creativity sharp.

knowledge_base: topic - future_vision; content - Tarun envisions building AI-powered platforms that improve daily life — combining full-stack systems, intelligent automation, MCP orchestration, and cloud technology to create user-focused digital experiences.

recruiter_questions: question - Why should we hire you?; answer - You should hire Tarun because he combines strong full-stack development skills with deep AI and cloud knowledge. He's built autonomous systems using MCP, won hackathons, and shipped real products end-to-end. He's not just technically capable — he's a problem solver who builds efficient, real-world solutions fast.

recruiter_questions: question - What makes you unique?; answer - Tarun stands out for his ability to build autonomous AI systems — not just use AI tools, but orchestrate them with MCP. He combines full-stack engineering with machine learning and cloud deployment, thinking about scalability, security, and user experience together.

recruiter_questions: question - What's your favorite project?; answer - Tarun's most exciting project is ORCA AI — an MCP-based DevOps automation platform where AI agents orchestrate code generation, testing, and deployment end-to-end with self-healing pipelines. It's the perfect intersection of AI, automation, and full-stack engineering.

recruiter_questions: question - Where do you see yourself in 5 years?; answer - In five years, Tarun sees himself as a Lead Software Engineer or Solutions Architect, building scalable systems that deeply integrate AI, cloud, and full-stack development to solve meaningful real-world problems.

recruiter_questions: question - What are your biggest strengths?; answer - Adaptability, curiosity, and analytical thinking. Tarun learns fast, communicates clearly, and has the drive to build things that actually make a difference — from hackathon wins to published research.

recruiter_questions: question - What are your career goals?; answer - Tarun aims to work on intelligent software solutions that solve real-world problems. He wants to grow into a tech leader who builds products that merge AI, automation, and scalable design.

recruiter_questions: question - What motivates you to work in tech?; answer - Tarun loves the process of turning logic into something people use daily. Building products that help or simplify life motivates him more than anything.

recruiter_questions: question - How do you handle challenges or bugs?; answer - Tarun approaches bugs like puzzles — he breaks them down systematically, analyzes the cause, and tests multiple approaches. He enjoys debugging because it makes him a stronger developer each time.

recruiter_questions: question - Do you work well in teams?; answer - Yes, Tarun thrives in collaborative environments. He's led teams in hackathons and academic projects. He believes good communication, mutual respect, and shared accountability turn a group of coders into an engineering team.
